sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
items: We collect information that you provide directly to us when using our Services.
We may collect your name, email address, account information, and configuration details required to operate the Google Calendar Plugin for Jitsi.
When you sign in with Google, we may collect your Google account email address to identify your account and provide access to the Services.
We may collect Jitsi server URLs, conference room names, and related configuration data that you provide through the admin dashboard.
We may collect usage data, diagnostic data, error logs, and communication data when you contact us for support.

sections.title: 2. Google Calendar and Google Account Data
items: Our Google Calendar Plugin for Jitsi uses Google OAuth permissions to provide calendar add-on functionality and to create, read, update, or manage calendar events as required by the Services.

The Services may request access to Google Calendar add-on execution, Google Calendar data, Google Calendar events, current calendar event read/write access, Google user email information, external request execution, and Google Apps Script execution as required for the plugin to function.
We use Google Calendar permissions only to provide the requested plugin functionality, including configuring Jitsi meeting links, managing conference room names, and interacting with calendar events.
We do not sell Google user data or use Google Calendar data for advertising purposes.
We do not access Google Calendar data beyond what is necessary to provide and maintain the Services.

sections.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
items: To provide, operate, maintain, and improve our Services.
To authenticate users and associate plugin configuration with the correct Google account.
To configure self-hosted Jitsi server URLs and manage conference room names.
To support Google Calendar add-on functionality and related calendar event actions.
To provide customer support and respond to inquiries.
To detect, prevent, and address technical issues, misuse, or unauthorized access.
To comply with legal obligations and protect our rights.

sections.title: 4. Data Security
items: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect personal information and configuration data.
Access to user data is restricted to authorized personnel and systems that require access to operate or support the Services.
We use reasonable safeguards to protect data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure.

sections.title: 5. Cookies and Tracking
items: We may use cookies or similar technologies to maintain sessions, improve user experience, and understand usage of the Services.
You can instruct your browser to refuse cookies or notify you when cookies are being sent.
Some parts of the Services may not function properly if cookies are disabled.

sections.title: 6. Third-Party Services
items: Our Services integrate with Google services, including Google Calendar and Google account authentication.
Your use of Google services is also subject to Google's own terms and privacy policies.
The Services may contain links to third-party websites or services that are not operated by us.
We are not responsible for the content, privacy policies, or practices of third-party websites or services.

sections.title: 7. Data Retention
items: We retain personal information, Google account email information, and configuration data only for as long as necessary to provide the Services.
We may retain certain data as required to comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, prevent misuse, and enforce our agreements.
You may request deletion of your data by contacting us using the contact details below.

sections.title: 8. Your Rights
items: You may request access to the personal data we hold about you.
You may request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information.
You may request deletion of your personal data, subject to legal or operational requirements.
You may object to certain processing activities where applicable.
You may request information about how your Google data is used by the Services.

sections.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
items: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.
We will notify users of material changes by updating this page or through the Services where appropriate.
Your continued use of the Services after changes are posted means that you accept the updated Privacy Policy.
